desc.zh: 从一次上车解锁整条线路，推导按乘车数分层的搜索与一次扫描不变量。
desc.en: Unlock an entire route per boarding and derive BFS layers with a scan-once invariant.

complexity: O(M + R) expected time; O(M + R) auxiliary space, M = total route entries, R = route count

concepts.name: Bus-count BFS layers
concepts.description: First discovery minimizes boardings; scan each route only once.

concepts.name: Stop-to-route inverted index
concepts.description: Look up incident routes without building all pairwise intersections.
